findings.summary: Reuse the compiler's symbol readers in the unused-export scanner.
Enumerate expired native cache entries once per cleanup and only inspect them for reporting when requested.
Share the mesh CPU stream field mapping between capture and recovery.
Preserve recovery metadata in fresh geometry without copying buffers that the upload replaces.
Cache TypeScript module resolution in the unused-export scanner.
Give the SDL buffer concern header an explicit dependency on the shared GPU error helper.
Validate each animation owner and traverse its registered groups once per capture pose.
Keep the capture pose protocol type private to its composing module.
Reuse verified atlas bundle bytes directly instead of maintaining a redundant bake-cache copy.
Load optional device atlas validation lazily so ordinary generation retains its existing startup cost.
Read and parse each completed generation manifest once for both source inputs and consumed atlas provenance.
